tasks.summary: Test-only fix correctly records the eight codeReview.task.* RPC methods in ADDED_RPC and updates the second test's claim to match. The diff is scoped exactly to the file named in the Task, matches the ISSUE's root cause/fix intent verbatim, and the eight listed methods are exactly the codeReview.task.* entries actually registered in handler-runtime.ts (cross-checked against method-class.ts). No runtime code changed.

testCoverage.explanation: The Task's named tests map 1:1 to the four test() blocks in src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts. I inspected each: (1) the key-set test now diffs the runtime's actual Object.keys() against RECORDED_RPC+ADDED_RPC, which — verified by grepping handler-runtime.ts and method-class.ts at the pinned commit — exactly contains the eight codeReview.task.* methods (activity, assignment, cleanup, progress, publish, result, scope, start), no more no less; (2) the renamed/duplicate-check test's hardcoded expected array exactly matches ADDED_RPC's codeReview.* subset, retains the codeReview.freshness-stays-in-RECORDED_RPC assertion, and keeps the Set-based no-duplicate check; (3) and (4) are pre-existing unaffected tests whose bodies are unchanged by this diff. The builder's reported run (exitCode 0, all 4 pass) was executed at the Task's exact commit 2717639c2, where handler-runtime.ts had not yet gained the later, unrelated designReview.* entries.

advice: Optional execution: I ran `npx tsx --test --test-force-exit src/daemon/__tests__/handler-runtime.test.ts` on the current checkout; the first test now fails again, but only because HEAD (and the dirty working tree, unrelated to this Story) has since added six designReview.* RPC methods that this same ADDED_RPC list does not yet record. I confirmed via `git show` that those designReview.* entries do not exist in handler-runtime.ts at the reviewed commit 2717639c2, so this is revision drift from later, out-of-scope work — not a defect in this Story's change. Since the next build/commit touching this area will need to extend ADDED_RPC again for designReview.*, flagging it so it isn't mistaken for a regression introduced here.
